facts.quote: We query all 10 models with a temperature of 1.0 to ensure output diversity.

facts.value: Table 2: Agentic misalignment rates across models under ablation.
facts.where: Table 2 caption and header
facts.quote: Table 2: Agentic misalignment rates across models under ablation. Misalignment is typically the highest when both the threat and opportunity are present and is near zero across model families when both are absent. The top three misaligned models for Threat/Opportunity are shown in bold. Dashed line (–) indicates ablation. Values are percentages.
facts.note: columns: Threat/Opportunity (full conditions), Threat/- (opportunity ablated), -/Opportunity, -/- ; values are percentages
